dedupe_keys.name: real network bras and onu application traffic

description: This release publishes anonymised application traffic captured from Broadband Remote Access Server and Optical Network Unit equipment in a real network. The research team supplies two PCAP archives, covering seven application categories, and separate CSV feature tables for each equipment source. The provider describes 23 BRAS trace files and 41 ONU trace files. Figshare marks the deposit CC0 1.0 and provides free access; a companion public repository demonstrates feature extraction but does not state a software licence in its inspected metadata. Geographic coverage and the complete acquisition period are not specified on the own landing page. The observations can calibrate application mixes, traffic classification and network-flow models for access infrastructure, and can complement backbone observations in data-cesnet-backbone-traffic-datasets or simulations using platform-ns-3. A caveat is that anonymised application traces are not a complete inventory of subscribers, links or service capacities. Capture location, preprocessing and class definitions should be checked before transferring the observed traffic mix to another network.
